QuestionStmt.S: If salicylic acid (138 u) reacts with acetic anhydride (102 u) to form aspirin (180 u) calculate % atom economy.

Solution.S:
Total mass of reactants = 138 + 102 = 240 u.

Molar mass of desired product (aspirin) = 180 u.

$$\text{Atom economy} = \frac{\text{Molar mass of desired product}}{\text{Total molar mass of reactants}} \times 100\%$$

$$= \frac{180}{240} \times 100\% = 0.75 \times 100\% = 75\%$$

Thus the correct option is D.
